nav.label: Sections
nav.myTasks: {count, plural, one {# open task of mine} other {# open tasks of mine}}

status.label: Your status: {status}
status.onlineHint: New conversations come to me in turn
status.awayHint: No new ones; my conversations stay with me

empty.title: No conversations yet
empty.text: Connect a Telegram bot or the website widget, and new customer conversations will show up here.

empty.title: Nobody is on shift right now
empty.text: See the queue, operators and SLA risks in real time. Invite operators to keep an eye on the workload.

empty.title: No data yet
empty.text: Metrics appear after the first closed conversations: response time, SLA and the share of questions the AI resolved on its own.

empty.title: No articles yet
empty.text: The AI answers customers from knowledge base articles. Start with the most common questions: delivery, payment, returns.

general.title: General
general.name: Name
general.localeHint: Default language of the workspace's system messages.
general.timezoneHint: Used for working hours and daily reports.
general.readOnly: Only the owner and admins can change workspace settings.

channels.title: Channels
channels.lead: Where customer requests come from: a Telegram bot, a personal Telegram account, a chat widget on your site or in your app, and a “Report a problem” button in your app. The conversations show up in the Inbox.
channels.noKey: The server has no encryption key (TOLKOVO_MASTER_KEY), so channels cannot be connected: tokens and sessions are stored encrypted only. Ask your server administrator.
channels.pendingHint: The login is cancelled automatically 15 minutes after the phone was entered.
channels.cancelLoginConfirm: Cancel the unfinished login? The phone and code are removed from the server.

disconnectConfirm.telegram_bot: Disconnect “{name}”? The bot stops sending messages to Tolkovo. The chats stay in the Inbox.
disconnectConfirm.telegram_user: Disconnect “{name}”? The Tolkovo session ends in Telegram and disappears from Devices. The chats stay in the Inbox.
disconnectConfirm.app: Disconnect “{name}”? All ingest keys are revoked and the app can no longer send reports. The conversations stay in the Inbox.
disconnectConfirm.widget: Disconnect “{name}”? The widget stops working on the site and in the app, and visitors’ sessions end. The conversations stay in the Inbox.

user.title: Personal account
user.text: Customers message the account directly, and your team replies from the panel on its behalf. No Telegram Premium needed.
user.needs: You need the phone where this account is open.
user.unavailable: Not set up on this server: the administrator needs to set TOLKOVO_TELEGRAM_API_ID and TOLKOVO_TELEGRAM_API_HASH (my.telegram.org).

token.step2: Send /newbot to create a bot, or /token to get the token of an existing one.
token.step3: Copy the token that looks like 123456789:AA… and paste it below.
token.label: Bot token
token.name: Name in the panel
token.nameHint: Optional. Defaults to the bot's name in Telegram.

risk.title: Before you connect
risk.work: Connect a separate work account: operators will see all of its private chats.
risk.limit: Telegram may restrict accounts run by software. You connect at your own risk.
risk.code: The login code arrives in Telegram on this account, so keep the phone at hand.
risk.agree: I understand, I am connecting a work account

code.label: Code
code.app: Telegram sent the code to the app: open the “Telegram” chat on the account {phone}.
code.sms: The code was sent by SMS to {phone}.
code.call: Telegram will call {phone} and read out the code.

password.text: The account has two-step verification: enter its Telegram cloud password.
password.label: Cloud password

done.telegram_bot: Bot “{name}” is connected. New messages will appear in the Inbox.
done.telegram_user: Account “{name}” is connected. Telegram lists it under Devices as Tolkovo.
done.app: Channel “{name}” is created. Hand the key to the app’s developer.
done.widget: Widget “{name}” is created. Hand the key and the code to the developer.

check.bot: Let's check the connection: open @{username} in Telegram and send any message.
check.botNoName: Let's check the connection: send the bot any message in Telegram.
check.user: Let's check the connection: message this account directly from another Telegram account.
check.received: Message received — it is in the Inbox already.

app.title: App
app.text: A “Report a problem” button in your desktop or mobile app: a report with logs and screenshots becomes a conversation.
app.needs: You need the app’s developer to embed the key.

appStep.text: The server issues an ingest key for the app and a secret for your server. They are shown once.
appStep.label: Name in the panel

widget.title: Widget
widget.text: A live chat on your site or inside your app, Electron included.
widget.needs: You’ll need a developer to add the npm package @tolkovo/widget.

widgetStep.text: Say where the widget will work. The server issues an identity signing secret for your server — it is shown once.
widgetStep.label: Name in the panel

errorCode.token_revoked: The bot's token was revoked in @BotFather, messages do not arrive. Disconnect the channel and connect the bot with a new token.
errorCode.session_revoked: The Tolkovo session was ended in Telegram (Devices), messages do not arrive. Disconnect the channel and sign in again.
errorCode.banned: Telegram has banned this account, messages do not arrive.
errorCode.other: The channel does not work. Disconnect it and connect it again.

app.once: The key and the secret are shown only now: the server keeps just a fingerprint and an encrypted copy. Save them in a password manager or hand them to the developer right away.
app.keyHint: Goes into the app. It can only send reports; if it leaks, issue a new one and revoke this one.
app.identityHint: For your server only, never the app: your server signs with it which user sent a report. Without a signature the report is marked “identity not confirmed”.
app.keysLead: A key lives in a build of the app. A new build can get its own key; revoke the old one once users have updated.
app.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key “{name}”? Apps with this key stop sending reports at once. Reports already received stay.
app.identityLead: Kept only on your server. If it leaked, replace it and update your server.
app.rotateConfirm: The old secret stops working at once: until your server gets the new one, reports come in marked “identity not confirmed”.

limit.max_report_mb: All files of a report, MB

widget.keyHint: Public: it goes into the page or the app. The widget works only on the addresses listed below.
widget.snippetHint: Colors, title and greeting go into the same call — see the package docs.
widget.originsHint: One per line: https://shop.example.com, https://*.example.com (every subdomain), app://name (an Electron app’s scheme). file:// and null are for an app loaded from files, but any page in a sandboxed iframe sends null too, so a custom scheme is better.
widget.originsSaved: Addresses saved. Removed addresses lose access within 30 seconds.
widget.analyticsLead: The widget sends goals to the counters the site already has: a visitor started a chat, left a contact, rated a conversation. No personal data: no text, names or contacts. The widget adds no counter and no cookie of its own.
widget.dataLayer: Google Tag Manager, or GA4 through GTM
widget.dataLayerHint: An event named after the goal in window.dataLayer.
widget.gtagHint: Calls gtag("event", goal name). If GA4 runs through GTM, turn on only the option above, or the goal counts twice.
widget.metrikaHint: Digits only, e.g. 12345678. Empty: nothing goes to Metrica.
widget.goalsHint: Latin letters, digits and _ . : -, up to 64 characters. Empty: the default name.
widget.analyticsSaved: Saved. Pages pick it up the next time they open.
widget.noOrigins: No addresses yet: the widget works nowhere until you add them.
widget.once: The identity signing secret is shown only now. Save it in a password manager or hand it to your server’s developer right away.
widget.identityHint: For your server only, never the page or the app: your server signs with it who is signed in. Without a signature the visitor comes in marked “identity not confirmed”.
widget.identityLead: Kept only on your server. If it leaked, replace it and update your server.
widget.rotateConfirm: The old secret stops working at once: until your server gets the new one, visitors come in marked “identity not confirmed”.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.lead: Tasks for developers from conversations: an operator creates a GitHub issue and, when the issue is closed, gets a draft reply to the customer.

github.title: GitHub Issues
github.noKey: The server has no encryption key (TOLKOVO_MASTER_KEY), so GitHub cannot be connected: the App key is stored only encrypted. Ask the server administrator.
github.dataNote: The issue text goes to GitHub (USA). The customer's name, email and files do not: the issue holds the problem, the app version and a link to the conversation in the panel. Staff open screenshots and logs by the link after signing in.
github.startText: GitHub opens the page that creates the App with its permissions filled in: issues only, no access to code. Confirm it, install the App on a repository and you come back here.
github.organizationHint: For example, zerno-team. Leave empty to create the App in your personal account.
github.waiting: Confirm the App on GitHub. If the GitHub page was closed, start again.
github.installText: The App “{slug}” is created. Install it on the repository new issues go to.
github.cancelNote: The App stays on GitHub: delete it in the App settings if you no longer need it.
github.created: The App is created. Install it on a repository next.
github.installed: GitHub is connected. Pick the repository for new issues.
github.repositoryHint: As owner/name. The App must be installed on it.
github.publicRepo: The repository is public: everyone sees the issue text. The issue form turns the customer quote off by default.
github.labelsHint: Comma-separated, up to 10. Put on every new issue.

placeholder.expected: what was expected, from the AI
placeholder.conversation_url: link to the conversation in the panel
placeholder.name: the customer's name

template.reply_ru: Reply about the fix, in Russian
template.reply_en: Reply about the fix, in English

github.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect GitHub? Tolkovo forgets the key of the App “{slug}” and new issues cannot be created. Existing issues stay on GitHub. Delete the App itself in its settings on GitHub.
github.disconnected: GitHub is disconnected. Delete the App in its settings on GitHub if you no longer need it.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.enabledHint: Turned off, the section leaves the menu and no new tasks are created. Existing tasks stay.

buttons.both: A task and a GitHub issue
buttons.bothHint: Both buttons in the conversation menu. "Create issue" appears once GitHub is connected.
buttons.tasksHint: Tasks stay in Tolkovo. No GitHub needed.
buttons.githubHint: The tasks section stays for tasks made by hand.

tasks.replyRu: Reply to the customer about a done task — in Russian
tasks.replyEn: Reply to the customer about a done task — in English
tasks.replyHint: Placeholders: {placeholders}. An operator sends the reply; Tolkovo never writes to the customer itself.
tasks.queuesHint: A queue groups tasks of one kind: development, infrastructure. Its members are notified about new tasks without an assignee.
tasks.noQueues: No queues yet. Tasks work without them too.
tasks.openTasks: {count, plural, one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
tasks.queueMembers: Who to tell about new tasks

bot.title: Telegram bot for notifications
bot.lead: A separate bot members get messages about tasks from. The bot of a support channel does not fit.
bot.noEncryption: TOLKOVO_MASTER_KEY is not set on the server: there is nowhere to keep the bot token safely. Ask the server administrator.
bot.connected: The bot @{bot} is connected. Members link their Telegram in "Personal → Notifications".
bot.dataNote: Telegram gets the task number, its title and a link. The description and customer data stay here. A new bot unlinks every member: they link again.
bot.tokenHint: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.

tasks.tagsHint: A tag shows what a task is about: design, interface, backend. Members tag tasks and can create a new tag right there. Here tags are renamed and deleted. Task tags are separate from conversation tags.
tasks.noTags: No tags yet. They can be created right in a task.
tasks.deleteTagConfirm: The tag will be removed from every task.

board.title: Board
board.text: Soft limits and age thresholds of the open columns. The board highlights what goes over, it never refuses a move.
board.hint: An empty field means no limit or no threshold. A queue's rules apply when the board shows that queue alone.

invite.title: Invite to the team
invite.roleHint: An operator answers conversations. An admin changes every setting except deleting the workspace.
invite.sent: Invitation sent to {email}. The link works for 7 days.
invite.link: Email is not set up on this server, so nothing was sent. Pass the link for {email} on yourself: it is shown once and works for 7 days.

routing.title: Distribution

modes.manualHint: Conversations wait in the queue; operators take them with «Take».
modes.round_robinHint: Each new conversation goes at once to the next operator who is «Online» with the panel open. Those already waiting are distributed as soon as you switch this on.

routing.rules: With nobody online, a conversation waits in the queue and goes to the first one back. A conversation given back to the queue does not return to the same operator while others are available. A resolved conversation the customer writes to again goes back to its operator if they are online, otherwise to the next one.
routing.onlineNow: {count, plural, one {# person takes conversations now:} other {# people take conversations now:}}
routing.nobodyOnline: Nobody takes conversations now: new ones will wait in the queue.

topics.title: Topics
topics.lead: The customer picks a topic before writing: the Telegram bot shows a button per topic, the widget shows them above the message field. The inbox shows the topic and filters by it. A topic sets the priority, who gets its conversations from automatic distribution and the queue of tasks.
topics.empty: No topics yet. Without them the bot and the widget ask nothing.
topics.deleteConfirm: Delete the topic? Its conversations and tasks will have none.
topics.name: Name
topics.nameHint: The customer sees it on a button in the bot and the widget.
topics.priorityHint: Conversations with a higher priority are given out of the queue first.
topics.membersHint: With «In turn» distribution only the checked members get the topic's conversations. None checked — everyone. Anyone may take one from the queue by hand.
topics.queueHint: A task from a conversation of this topic goes to this queue unless another is picked.

ai.title: Provider, key and spending
ai.lead: Your own key to an AI model and a monthly budget. For now AI drafts issues; the customer bot, handoff to people and the operator assistant come later.
ai.enabledHint: While it is off, AI is never called and spends nothing. The connection can be checked while it is off.

providers.anthropicHint: Claude models. Get a key in the Anthropic Console, API Keys.
providers.openaiHint: GPT models. Get a key in the OpenAI platform settings, API keys.
providers.deepseekHint: DeepSeek models. Get a key at platform.deepseek.com, API keys. DeepSeek's servers are in China; keep that in mind for your customers' personal data.
providers.openai_compatibleHint: Your own server or a service with the same API: Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, OpenRouter.

ai.baseUrlHint: Including /v1. An outside server only over https://; http:// is for a server on a private network, if the Tolkovo server admin allowed it in TOLKOVO_EGRESS_ALLOW_PRIVATE. The key belongs to the server: enter it again when the address changes.
ai.baseUrlInvalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
ai.keyOptional: API key, if the server needs one
ai.keyHint: Stored encrypted and never shown in full again.
ai.keySaved: Key {hint} is saved. Enter a new one to replace it.
ai.keyLost: The saved key belongs to another provider and will be removed when you save.
ai.keyRequired: Enter an API key to turn AI on.
ai.keyInvalid: The key must not contain spaces.
ai.modelHint: The provider's exact model name. Pick a suggestion or type your own.
ai.modelRequired: Enter a model to turn AI on.
ai.modelInvalid: A model name is Latin letters, digits and . _ : / @ + -, up to 100 characters.
ai.pricesHint: Suggested models fill in their prices; check them against the provider's pricing page. For your own server you can leave 0.
ai.priceInvalid: A price is a number from 0 to 1000.
ai.budgetHint: Once spending in a calendar month reaches the budget, AI is not called until the next month. Empty means no limit.
ai.budgetInvalid: The budget is a number from 0 to 1,000,000.
ai.budgetNear: More than 80% of the budget is used.
ai.budgetSpent: This month's budget is spent: AI is not called until the next month.
ai.pricesUnset: The model has no prices, so spending is not counted and the budget does not limit calls.
ai.privacy: Email addresses, phone numbers, card numbers, SNILS, INN and passport numbers are replaced with placeholders before anything goes to the model. Every call is logged; request texts are kept 30 days.
ai.noEncryption: TOLKOVO_MASTER_KEY is not set on the server, so an API key cannot be saved. Ask the server admin to set it.
ai.checkHint: The check sends a short request with the saved settings and costs a few tokens.

bot.title: The AI bot answers customers
bot.lead: The bot answers only from the knowledge base. When it does not know or is not sure, it tells the customer it is calling a colleague and hands the conversation to the queue. What the bot knows:
bot.aiOff: AI is off: the bot does not answer until AI is turned on above.
bot.channelsHint: The bot takes new conversations of these channels. Ones started earlier stay with people.
bot.noChannels: No channels yet. Connect one under Channels.
bot.topicsOffHint: The bot hands conversations of these topics to the queue at once.
bot.confidenceHint: An answer the bot is less sure of goes to people. 75 is strict; lower makes the bot answer more often but risk mistakes.
bot.handoffHint: The customer reads it when the bot hands over without words of its own. Up to {max} characters; empty uses the default phrase.
bot.handoffPlaceholder: I'm passing your question to our support team. The reply will come here, in this chat.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.lead: The AI bot answers customers from here. The bot never reads the whole base: for each question the search picks up to 5 matching entries, and only they reach the model. What the base does not say, the bot does not make up: it hands the question to an operator.
knowledge.guideLead: The bot sees these fields with every question, even when the search finds nothing.
knowledge.aboutHint: Who you are, what the app is, who it is for, its main features and what the bot does not discuss. Up to {max} characters.
knowledge.rulesHint: When the bot hands the conversation to a person at once, even if it knows the answer: payments, refunds, a blocked account, a bug in the app. When the bot does not know the answer, it hands over anyway. Up to {max} characters.
knowledge.checklist: What to collect for an IT task
knowledge.checklistHint: When a question looks like a bug in the app, the bot asks the customer by this list and only then creates a task for IT. One item per line; mark optional ones “(optional)”. Up to {max} characters.
knowledge.checklistPlaceholder:
Account email
Device and system
App version
What you did, step by step
What you expected and what happened
Screenshot (optional)
knowledge.importLead: The developers' AI agent writes tolkovo-knowledge.json by guides/knowledge-base-brief.md. Entries with the same title are updated, new ones are added, the rest stay as they are.
knowledge.importNotJson: This is not a JSON file.
knowledge.importWrongFormat: This is not a knowledge file: the format must be “{expected}”.
knowledge.searchLead: Write a question the way a customer would and see which entries the bot gets. Trying costs nothing: the model is not called.
knowledge.searchNothing: Nothing found. The bot will not answer such a question; it will hand it to an operator.
knowledge.searchFound: {count, plural, one {The bot gets # entry:} other {The bot gets # entries:}}
knowledge.articlesLead: An article describes a feature or a procedure in full. A question with its answer covers a frequent question, including what the app does not have.
knowledge.empty: No entries yet. Add the first one or import a file.
knowledge.question: Question
knowledge.bodyHint: Markdown. The bot retells only what is written here: give steps, button names and numbers exactly.
knowledge.urlHint: Optional. The bot shows it to the customer under the answer.
knowledge.urlInvalid: The link must start with http:// or https://.
knowledge.topicsHint: The bot uses the entry only in conversations of these topics. None checked: in every conversation.
knowledge.published: Published: the bot answers from this entry

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: This is how teammates see you in the team and in conversations.
profile.emailHint: The address you sign in with. It can’t be changed yet.
profile.languageHint: Saved in your profile and used on all your devices.
profile.emailUnverified: Email not confirmed: password resets and important notices go to it.
profile.resent: Email sent. The link works for 48 hours.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: The theme is stored in this browser only: choose it separately on other devices.

device.title: On this device
device.text: Sounds and desktop notifications are set up in each browser separately. With several tabs open, only one of them plays sounds.

desktop.title: Desktop notifications
desktop.default: The browser has not asked yet whether it may show notifications.
desktop.denied: Blocked in the browser. Allow them in the site settings (the icon left of the address) and reload the page.
desktop.unsupported: This browser does not show desktop notifications.
desktop.hint: When you are given a conversation or a customer writes in yours while you do not have it open. Clicking the notification opens the conversation.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.assigned: A conversation is given to me
sounds.message: A customer writes in my conversation
sounds.queued: A new conversation in the queue
sounds.hint: No sound while the conversation is open on your screen.

test.sent: Sent. If nothing appeared, check the browser permission and the system's Do Not Disturb mode.

email.title: By email
email.missedHint: If a customer message in your conversation stays unread, an email goes to {email}. The email has no conversation text.
email.unavailable: Outgoing email is not set up on this server, so no emails are sent. Ask your administrator.
email.unverified: {email} is not confirmed: emails start once you confirm it.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.lead: Messages about tasks: when a task is assigned to you and when a task without an assignee appears in your queue. A message has the number, the title and a link, never the description or customer data.
telegram.noBot: An admin has not added a bot for notifications yet.
telegram.toSettings: Add it in the task settings
telegram.steps: Open the bot @{bot} and press Start. The link works for 15 minutes.
telegram.waiting: Waiting for you to press Start…

password.title: Change password
password.text: Changing the password signs you out on every other device.
password.done: Password changed. You were signed out on other devices.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.text: Devices where your account is signed in.

api.title: API access
api.lead: A token lets a script or an AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor) work with tasks on your behalf. It can do no more than you, and only in tasks: conversations, customers and settings stay closed to it.

new.title: New token
new.name: Name
new.nameHint: Where it will work, e.g. "Claude Code, laptop".

issued.title: Token issued
issued.once: Copy it now: it will not be shown again. Keep it like a password.
issued.mcpHint: Run the command in a terminal: the agent sees tasks through MCP. Other MCP clients connect to the same address with the Authorization header.

all.title: Members' tokens
all.text: Every live token of the workspace. Revoke a token that leaked or is no longer needed.

row.revoked: The token is revoked and no longer works.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.subtitle: The “{name}” workspace is ready. Check the basic settings — it takes a minute.

created.title: Workspace created
created.text: Workspace address: {slug}. You are its owner.

locale.title: Language and time zone
locale.text: We took them from your browser. If the workspace works in another time zone, change it.

validation.email: Enter an email address, for example anna@example.com.
validation.passwordLength: The password must be 8 to 128 characters.
validation.slug: 3 to 40 characters: Latin letters, digits and inner hyphens.
validation.phone: Digits, spaces, brackets and hyphens, 3 to 32 characters, e.g. +44 20 7946 0958.

errors.rateLimitedLater: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.

errors.slugTaken: This address is taken. Choose another one.

errors.issueInProgress: An issue of this conversation is being created already. Wait for it.
errors.issueLinked: The conversation is linked to this issue already.

errors.issueState: This works only for an issue that could not be created.

errors.invalidAccessToken: This token is not valid: it was revoked or has expired.

errors.topicExists: A topic with this name exists.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The screen didn't load because of an error in the app. Try again. If the error persists, reload the page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The link is outdated, or there is a typo in the address.

auth.tagline: Support in Telegram and on your website: AI on the first line, people when it matters.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to answer your customers.

register.title: New workspace
register.closed: This server takes no new workspaces. To join your team, ask an admin for an invitation: it arrives by email or as a link.
register.subtitle: A workspace is your company in Tolkovo: channels, team and conversations.
register.name: Your name
register.slugHint: Latin letters, digits and hyphens, for example zerno-coffee.

link.missing: The address has no link key. Open the whole link from the email.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: We will email a link to set a new password to the account's address.
forgot.sent: If an account uses this address, the email is on its way. The link works for 1 hour.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Changing the password signs you out everywhere; sign in again.
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.

invite.title: Team invitation
invite.subtitle: You are invited to {workspace}. Role: {role}.
invite.invalid: This invitation is no longer valid: it was accepted, revoked or has expired. Ask the admin to invite you again.
invite.name: Your name
invite.nameHint: This is how colleagues will see you.
invite.existing: This address already has a Tolkovo account. Enter its password and the workspace joins your others.

verify.title: Email confirmation
verify.done: Email confirmed. Password resets and important notices will come to it.
verify.invalid: This link is no longer valid: it was used or has expired. Send a new email from your profile.

empty.mine: You have no conversations in progress
empty.queue: The queue is empty — nice work
empty.hint: New requests show up here by themselves, no need to reload.

pick.title: Pick a conversation
pick.text: Open a conversation from the list. Messages and changes arrive by themselves.

inbox.viewing: {names} {count, plural, one {is in this conversation} other {are in this conversation}}

feed.label: Conversation messages
feed.empty: No messages in this conversation yet
feed.notFound: The conversation does not exist or is not available

sender.note: Note · the customer does not see it

composer.noteHint: The customer will not see it
composer.notePlaceholder: A note for colleagues — the customer will not see it
composer.keys: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line, Ctrl+Alt+N for a note
composer.collision: A new message came in while you were typing.
composer.takeFirst: This conversation is in the queue. Take it to reply.
composer.someoneElse: {name} handles this conversation. You can reply after a transfer and leave a note now.
composer.noReply: You cannot reply in this conversation.
composer.closed: The conversation is closed for good; replies are not possible.
composer.error: The message was not sent. Your text is kept — try again.
composer.errorOffline: No connection to the server. Your text is kept — send it when the connection is back.
composer.errorNotAssignee: This conversation is no longer yours: its assignee replies. Your text is kept.
composer.sentNotClosed: The message was sent, but the conversation was not closed.

actions.conflict: Someone changed the conversation first. It is up to date now — try again.
actions.notAssignee: This conversation is no longer yours.
actions.invalid: This action is not available now: the conversation status changed.
actions.error: That did not work. Check the connection and try again.

tags.label: Tags
tags.createError: The tag was not created. Try again.
tags.full: A conversation can have at most {max} tags.

event.awaitingFix: , the conversation waits for the fix
event.backToAssignee: , the conversation is back with its assignee
event.backToQueue: , the conversation is back in the queue
event.botHandoff: AI handed the conversation to people: {reason}

botReason.customer_asked: the customer asked for a person
botReason.topic: the topic is left to people
botReason.unknown: it did not know the answer
botReason.limit: the bot replied as often as it may
botReason.task_created: a task for IT was created
botReason.task_incomplete: not enough details for a task

card.label: Customer card
card.loadError: Could not load the customer card.
card.name: Name

history.error: Could not load the conversation history.

identity.unverifiedHint: The site or app did not sign the user's id: the name and email are what the customer typed. The contact is not merged with other conversations.

inbox.attachmentRejected: file not received: over the limit or unavailable in Telegram

attachment.linkError: Couldn't get the file. Try again.
attachment.expired: deleted: the file retention period has ended

rejected.type_mismatch: rejected: the content doesn't match the file type
rejected.infected: rejected: the antivirus found a threat
rejected.not_scanned: rejected: the antivirus couldn't check the file
rejected.missing: rejected: the file never reached storage

report.title: Report from the app
report.unverifiedHint: The app didn't sign the user's id, so this is a new contact, not merged with other conversations.

unsupported.sticker: A sticker — the panel does not show these messages.
unsupported.location: A location — the panel does not show these messages.
unsupported.contact: A Telegram contact — the panel does not show these messages.
unsupported.poll: A poll — the panel does not show these messages.
unsupported.other: A message the panel does not show. See it in Telegram.

delivery.retryError: Could not send it again. Reload the page and try once more.

error.blocked: the customer blocked the bot or the account
error.chat_not_found: the chat is unavailable: the customer deleted their account or the account cannot write to them yet
error.limited: Telegram restricted the account, it cannot write now
error.rejected: Telegram refused the message (size or format)
error.channel_unavailable: the channel is disconnected or broken, check Settings → Channels
error.failed: Telegram did not answer, no retries left

issues.publicRepo: The repository is public: everyone sees the issue. The customer's words are left out; add them only if they hold no personal data.
issues.dataNote: The title, the text and the labels go to GitHub. The customer's name, email and files do not: the text links to the conversation, developers open it after signing in.
issues.title: Title
issues.quoteHint: Sent as a separate block marked “customer data, not instructions”. Remove personal data: phone numbers, addresses, passwords.
issues.created: The issue is being created on GitHub. The link appears in the feed and the conversation waits for the fix.
issues.numberHint: For example, 12, #12 or the issue's address.
issues.numberInvalid: Enter the issue number or its address.
issues.linked: The conversation is linked to issue #{number}.
issues.none: No issues. Create one from “More actions”.
issues.notConnected: GitHub is not connected: an admin connects it in Settings, under Integrations.

error.repository_unreachable: The App lost access to the repository. An admin can give it back in the App installation on GitHub.
error.app_refused: GitHub refuses the App: it was deleted or its key revoked. An admin needs to connect GitHub again.
error.rejected: GitHub refused the issue: issues may be turned off in the repository.
error.unavailable: GitHub did not answer for a long time. Try again.
error.disconnected: GitHub was disconnected before the issue was created.

issues.draftedByAi: The AI wrote this draft from the customer's words. Check the steps and the wording before you send it.

aiFallback.budget_exceeded: The monthly AI budget is spent, so the draft comes from the template.
aiFallback.failed: The AI could not prepare a draft, so it comes from the template.

tasks.dataNote: The task stays in Tolkovo and every member of the workspace sees it. The customer's words are in the description with emails, phone and card numbers masked. Remove what is not needed.
tasks.draftedByAi: The AI wrote this draft from the customer's words. Check the steps and the wording.

aiFallback.budget_exceeded: The month's AI budget is spent, so the draft is the customer's words.
aiFallback.failed: The AI could not write a draft, so it is the customer's words.

tasks.created: Task #{number} created. The conversation waits until it is closed.
tasks.pickRequired: Pick a task from the list.
tasks.linked: The conversation is linked to task #{number}.
tasks.none: No tasks. Create one in the "More actions" menu.
tasks.done: Task #{number} is done. A draft reply:

rating.line: The customer rated the conversation {score} of 5

empty.hint: Create a task here or from a conversation, in its "More actions" menu.

pick.title: Pick a task
pick.text: The list is on the left. Tasks from conversations keep them waiting until they are closed.

tasks.deleteConfirm: Delete the task? Its conversations stop waiting for it. This cannot be undone.

activity.filesRemoved: A file was removed from the description

tasks.commentPlaceholder: A comment for the team. The customer won't see it.
tasks.notifyAssignee: The assignee is notified in the panel, and in Telegram if they linked it.
tasks.notifyQueue: Without an assignee, the members of the queue are notified.

files.title: Files
files.hint: or paste a screenshot (Ctrl+V), or drop files here
files.badType: this type of file cannot be attached

tags.label: Tags
tags.createError: The tag was not created. Try again.
tags.full: A task can have at most {max} tags.

board.label: Task board
board.help: Arrows move between cards and columns, Enter opens, Shift and an arrow move to the next column, M moves, A takes.

rule.open: Waiting for someone to take them. The top one goes first.
rule.in_progress: Being done. A task without an assignee goes to whoever moved it.
rule.review: The change is on the dev server, being checked.
rule.verified: Checked on dev, waiting for production.
rule.done: In production. Waiting conversations went back to their assignees with a reply draft.

board.older: Older ones are in the Closed list
board.emptyHint: Create the first one, or make a task from a conversation in its More actions menu.
board.conversations: {count, plural, one {# customer waits for this task} other {# customers wait for this task}}

confirm.title: Is the task in production?
confirm.text: {count, plural, one {# conversation goes} other {# conversations go}} back to their assignees with a reply draft. An operator sends it.

board.overLimit: Over the limit ({limit}): finish what is started first
board.dropOver: It will be {count} of {limit}, over the limit

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.title: Block task {number}
blocked.reasonPlaceholder: Waiting for an answer, an access or another task
blocked.hint: The status stays. The mark comes off by itself when the task is closed.

test.title: Tolkovo: test
test.body: This is how conversation notifications will look.

channelAlert.many: Channels down: {count}. Customer messages through them do not arrive, replies do not go out.
